descriere:
Nivel de vechime: Nivel mediu de experiență
Tip de angajare: Full-time
Sectoare de activitate: Servicii IT și consultanță IT și Telecomunicații
SCUT is an independent entity, Orange Romania being its main shareholder, as part of its strategy to strengthen digital resilience at a national level. The company provides a unified protection service, which offers a complete and modular vision of customer infrastructures, multiple layers of protection and a coordinated response to incidents.
 SCUT is supported by an elite team with over 20 years of experience in the field of cybersecurity, but also by the global expertise of Orange Cyberdefense, SCUT’s strategic partner. Thus, the entity benefits from the know-how and resources of a group active in over 160 countries, with 18 Security Operations Centers (SOC) and over 250 researchers and analysts.
 What We’re Looking For 
 We are looking for a hands-on IT professional with strong experience in IT infrastructure administration, endpoint management, and technical support across Windows, macOS, and Linux environments.
 What You’ll Be Doing 
 Internal IT Support & Endpoint Management 
Own and manage SCUT's internal IT environment, ensuring reliable and secure day-to-day operations.
Provide hands-on technical support for employees using macOS and Windows devices , including troubleshooting hardware, operating systems, applications, and connectivity issues.
Manage employee IT onboarding and offboarding, including device provisioning, account creation, access rights, and equipment lifecycle management.
Maintain endpoint security, software updates, device compliance, and configuration standards.
Implement and maintain standardized device configurations and provisioning processes.
Manage IT assets, software licenses, hardware inventory, and equipment lifecycle.
Troubleshoot and resolve technical issues, ensuring minimal disruption to business operations.
 Microsoft 365 & Identity Administration 
Administer and maintain the company's Microsoft 365 tenant , including Exchange Online, SharePoint, Teams, OneDrive, and related services.
Manage Microsoft Entra ID , user identities, groups, permissions, MFA, Conditional Access, and security policies.
Configure and maintain device management and compliance policies using Microsoft Intune.
Monitor Microsoft 365 service health, security configurations, licensing, and operational issues.
Manage access permissions and security configurations across Microsoft 365 applications.
Support collaboration and productivity initiatives across Microsoft 365 services.
Ensure proper implementation of identity security, access control, and account lifecycle management.
 Infrastructure, Lab Environments & Internal Applications 
Deploy, administer, and maintain Linux servers, virtual machines, containers, and internal infrastructure services .
Manage internal laboratory and testing environments used by cybersecurity engineering, SOC, and technical teams.
Maintain virtualization and containerization platforms such as Proxmox, VMware, Docker, or similar technologies .
 Administer, maintain, and troubleshoot the company's internal AI server infrastructure , ensuring system availability, performance, security, and operational reliability.
Ensure availability, security, backup, and recovery capabilities for internal systems.
Provide operational support for internally developed applications , including deployment, configuration, troubleshooting, monitoring, and maintenance.
Collaborate with developers and engineering teams to support application integrations, updates, and infrastructure requirements.
Maintain internal network services, VPN connectivity, DNS, and other supporting infrastructure components.
Proactively identify infrastructure improvements and maintain relevant technical documentation.
 Customer Onboarding & Security Operations Support 
Support SOC and Security Operations teams with the technical onboarding of new MDR customers .
Assist with the deployment, configuration, and troubleshooting of security agents, connectors, and integrations across customer environments.
Support technical integration activities involving EDR, XDR, SIEM, and SOAR platforms , working alongside specialized security engineers.
Help configure connectivity, API integrations, authentication, and data flows between customer environments and SCUT security platforms.
Troubleshoot infrastructure, networking, and system-level issues affecting customer onboarding or security service delivery.
Develop and maintain scripts to simplify customer onboarding and recurring operational tasks.
Collaborate with SOC analysts, security engineers, and technical leads to ensure smooth integration of customer environments.
Support technical documentation and standardization of customer onboarding procedures.
 What You Need To Know / Have 
 5+ years of experience in IT administration, systems engineering, infrastructure operations, or similar hands-on technical roles.
Strong practical experience administering Microsoft 365 , particularly Exchange Online, Entra ID, Intune, SharePoint, and Teams.
Proven experience supporting and managing Windows and macOS endpoints in corporate environments.
Solid knowledge of Linux administration , including CLI, system services, permissions, networking, package management, and troubleshooting.
Hands-on experience with PowerShell, Python, or Bash scripting for system administration and operational tasks.
Experience with virtualization and container technologies such as Proxmox, VMware, Hyper-V, Docker, or Kubernetes .
Good understanding of networking fundamentals , including TCP/IP, DNS, DHCP, VPN, VLANs, routing, and firewall configurations.
Experience with application deployment, web services, APIs, databases, and troubleshooting .
Knowledge of IT security principles, including endpoint protection, patch management, access control, backups, and vulnerability management.
Experience integrating systems and applications using APIs and scripts.
Familiarity with Git, application configuration management, and basic deployment workflows .
Ability to independently troubleshoot complex technical issues across endpoints, servers, networks, and applications.
Strong organizational skills and ability to manage multiple technical priorities.
Good English communication skills, both written and spoken.
 Nice To Have 
Experience working in a cybersecurity company, MSSP, MDR, or SOC environment .
Familiarity with security platforms such as CrowdStrike, SentinelOne, Bitdefender, Sekoia, Splunk, or QRadar .
Experience with Microsoft Graph API, Power Automate, and Microsoft Copilot .
Familiarity with AI/ML infrastructure , including GPU servers, Linux-based AI environments, and deployment or maintenance of self-hosted AI platforms.
Knowledge of Infrastructure-as-Code and configuration management tools such as Ansible or Terraform.
Experience with CI/CD pipelines, Git, and application deployment processes.
Familiarity with cloud environments such as Microsoft Azure or AWS.
Experience supporting internal development teams and maintaining self-hosted applications.
Knowledge of monitoring and observability tools such as Grafana, Prometheus, or Zabbix.
Relevant certifications such as Microsoft 365 Administrator, Azure Administrator, RHCSA, or equivalent.
 We encourage all candidate profiles, regardless of gender, age, race, citizenship, ethnicity, color, language, religion, social origin, genetic traits, sexual orientation, permanent or temporary disability, nationality, political choice, social category or social origins, situation or family responsibility, belonging to a disadvantaged category, membership or trade union activity.
